title: sanguisorba minor var. stenolopha
intro: Sanguisorba minor var. stenolopha, commonly known as Dwarf Burnet, is a flowering plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Therapeutically, Sanguisorba minor var. stenolopha is believed to act as an astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
